input: Shadow a colleague in a different department

gold.taskTitle: Shadow a Colleague in a Different Department
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete a job shadowing experience with a colleague from another department to gain exposure to their role and work.

questions.title: Which department do you want to shadow?
questions.description: Identify the specific department the user is targeting for the shadowing experience.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific colleague in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a pre-existing contact or needs help identifying someone to shadow.

questions.title: What is your main reason for shadowing that department?
questions.description: Understand the motivation — career switch, curiosity, collaboration, skill-building, etc.

questions.title: How long do you want the shadowing session to last?
questions.description: Clarify the intended duration — a few hours, a full day, or multiple days.

questions.title: When do you want this shadowing to happen?
questions.description: Pin down the target date or timeframe the user has in mind.

questions.title: Does your company have a formal shadowing or approval process?
questions.description: Find out if there are HR policies, manager approvals, or structured programs already in place.

questions.title: What does a successful shadowing experience look like to you?
questions.description: Identify the specific outcomes or takeaways the user hopes to get from the experience.
